coverage_summary: Top + side (Autocar-type, dimensioned) for a LWB 911E; plus a 3-view of the 1970 Monte-Carlo 911 S rally car. No clean front/rear line drawing of a road LWB coupe found - use the SWB front/rear views (../02) and add the 1969+ flared arches.

blueprints.depicts: Titled 'Porsche 911E (1968)' but the printed wheelbase is 7 ft 5.5 in (2273 mm) = long-wheelbase B-series (MY1969+); Fuchs 5-spoke wheels drawn.
blueprints.labeled_dims: wheelbase 7 ft 5.5 in, ground clearance 6 in, interior dims
blueprints.accuracy_notes: Measured WB/L 0.540 (auto, overlay verified; front extreme touches crop edge, +/-1%). The printed 7 ft 5.5 in wheelbase matches the upper end of the Wikipedia classic-911 wheelbase range 2211-2268 mm https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Porsche_911_(classic); compare the ratio with the LWB length in geometry.json.
blueprints.ratio_check_vs_official: measured WB/L 0.540 vs official 2271/4147 mm = 0.548 -> -1.4% : close (1-2%)

measurement_method: measured_wb_over_len = wheelbase / overall length measured in pixels on the side view (hub centres, bumper extremes); wheels auto-detected with OpenCV HoughCircles and checked on an overlay, or read manually from a 10-px gridded zoom. Typical uncertainty +/-1% (large drawings) to +/-2% (small/low-res). Compare with the sourced dimensions in ../../geometry.json.
